newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says Middle East peace is dead.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Middle East peace is dead.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati on Saturday condemned Israel for killing Palestinians and said the Middle East peace process was dead.
"One more time, under another excuse, Palestinians were slaughtered by Zionists," Velayati told Iranian television in a satellite link-up from New York.
"Today the so-called contract of peace is dead and its strongest supporters today cannot dare put it forward very seriously," he said.
Four days of fierce clashes between Israeli and Palestinian forces in the West Bank and Gaza Strip have left some 70 people dead, most of them Palestinians.
The violence erupted on Wednesday over Israel's decision to open a tunnel near Moslem shrines in Jerusalem.
Palestinians called the tunnel's opening as an assault on Islamic holy shrines and an Israeli attempt to "Judaise" Arab East Jerusalem, occupied by Israel in 1967 and later annexed.
